Agent '''Shyrack''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Stationed in the [[King's Pass]], he sent a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to set [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and [[House Baliss|Baliss]] against each other.
